description: APPolicy is the Schema for the APPolicy API

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: APPolicySpec defines the desired state of APPolicy

policy.description: Defines the App Protect policy - can be inline policy or reference

status.description: APPolicyStatus defines the observed state of Policy

compilerVersion.description: CompilerVersion is the version of the compiler used to build this bundle.

location.description: Location is the path/URL where the compiled bundle is stored; only set when State == “ready”

observedGeneration.description:
ObservedGeneration is the metadata.generation of the APPolicy resource
that was used to produce this policy bundle.
This tracks which version of the policy spec generated the current bundle.

sha256.description: Sha256 is the SHA256 hash of the bundle file

signatures.description: Signatures holds the revisions of embedded signature files – only if this is a policy bundle.

attackSignatures.description: AttackSignatures is the timestamp of the attack signatures

botSignatures.description: BotSignatures is the timestamp of the bot signatures

threatCampaigns.description: ThreatCampaigns is the timestamp of the threat campaigns signatures

userDefinedSignatures.description:
UserDefinedSignatures lists the APUserSig CRs whose signatures are included in this bundle.
Each entry has a name (the APUserSig CR name, which equals its signature tag) and a
generation (the Kubernetes metadata.generation of that CR at compile time).

state.description: State is the current bundle state (pending, processing, ready, invalid)

currentRevisionInProgress.description:
CurrentRevisionInProgress records the revision from metadata.annotations
for which a compilation job is currently pending or processing. This
allows the controller to avoid starting duplicate jobs for the same
revision, while still permitting a new job when the desired revision
changes mid-flight.

inProgressBundleLocation.description:
InProgressBundleLocation stores the S3 location of the bundle currently
being compiled or imported. It is cleared once that work finishes.

inProgressGeneration.description:
InProgressGeneration records the metadata.generation for which a
compilation job is currently pending or processing.
This allows the controller to avoid mis-attributing compilation results
when the spec changes mid-flight.

lastAppliedRevision.description:
LastAppliedRevision records the revision from metadata.annotations
that was used for the last successful compilation. If the current
metadata revision differs from this value, the controller will
trigger a recompilation.

lastGoodBundle.description:
LastGoodBundle stores the most recent successfully compiled bundle metadata.
This field is only populated when the current bundle state is NOT "ready",
to enable fallback to the last known good configuration.

Each entry has a name (the APUserSig CR name, which equals its signature tag) and a

state.description: State is the current bundle state (pending, processing, ready, invalid)

observedGeneration.description:
ObservedGeneration is the most recent metadata.generation for which the
controller successfully reconciled (compiled) the policy bundle.
This field tracks the Kubernetes metadata.generation to determine if
a new compilation is needed when the spec changes.
If metadata.generation is greater than this value, the controller will
trigger a new compilation.

observedPolicyName.description:
ObservedPolicyName is the policy name as declared inside the policy
file/bundle itself. This is usually identical to the APPolicy CR name,
but it is not guaranteed, especially when the policy is fetched from
external references.

policyLocation.description:
PolicyLocation stores the S3 location of the policy JSON currently used for
compilation. It is empty when the APPolicy directly imports a prebuilt bundle.

previousBundleLocation.description:
PreviousBundleLocation stores the S3 location of the previous (N-1) bundle.
When a new bundle is compiled, the old bundle is NOT deleted immediately
because traffic nodes may still be fetching it. Instead, the old location
is saved here. On the NEXT successful compilation, the bundle at this
location (now N-2) is deleted, and the current bundle location takes its place.

datetime.description: Datetime is when the last compile/validation occurred.

errors.description: Errors holds any validation or compile errors (only if State == “invalid”)

isCompiled.description: IsCompiled is true if we compiled the bundle; false means we accepted a pre-compiled one.
